versionChangelog.title: New version {version}
versionChangelog.description: Key updates and changes to know.

items.0: Harmonized validation (react-hook-form + Zod) for Profiles, Groups, Probes and Standards.
items.1: Consistent error messages on required fields.

items.0: Unified cards (buttons, type icons, tooltips, light mode).
items.1: Primary-colored filters/actions, improved sorting and views.
items.2: Latest value in the measurements table.
items.3: Added the Audit tab in location details.
items.4: Removed min/max display from monitoring (cards and details).
items.5: Quick alarm acknowledgment from the monitoring card.
items.6: Status legend with colored dots in the monitoring header.
items.7: Decimal precision applied on cards and tables.
items.8: Disabled locations grid now uses full width.

items.0: Date range picker to filter measurements.
items.1: Measurements tab adapted for locations with monitoring disabled.

items.0: Sticky headers with blur, adjusted heights and clearer borders.
items.3: Configurable time zone for date displays.

items.0: Create locations without a probe with confirmation.
items.1: GSO type: frequency locked to 15 min.

items.0: Agent secret alert enabled by default in production (opt-in in dev via flag).
New 403, 404, and 500 error pages with animated, modern visuals.
